# ChipFlow

> A self-hosted kanban board with a pomodoro timer and time tracking, and a
> JSON API for agents.

Every API call sends `Authorization: Bearer cf_...`. The owner creates a
token under Settings > API tokens, or an agent pairs with
`POST /api/v1/auth/device` and the owner approves the code in the browser.

## Docs

- [Agent skill]({base}/skill.md): the agent workflow, in Agent Skills format
- [API reference]({base}/docs/api.md): every operation, schema and rule
- [OpenAPI]({base}/api/v1/openapi.json): the machine-readable contract
- [Version]({base}/api/v1/version): build version and `skill_version`
